scenario: A nephrology relay should close after the referral ticket, provider message, and case note still point to the same fresh referral lane.
user_instruction: Please close the nephrology relay for case MED-1616. Start from referral ticket RFT-1616 and only take the approved close step if the support trail still lines up.

medical_referral_case_tickets.body_text: Referral ticket RFT-1616: check provider message PM-1616 and case note CN-1616 before closing the nephrology relay. If the old nephrology referral is no longer active, the approved close step is to submit a fresh nephrology referral.

medical_provider_messages.body_text: Provider message PM-1616: the previous nephrology referral was closed after an intake mismatch. Reopen the lane only by submitting a fresh nephrology referral.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1616: the relay still closes through a fresh nephrology referral when the current status confirms no active referral remains.
